capital_structure_tranches.tranche_name: QIB Sukuk Ltd 5.581% Senior Unsecured Sukuk due Nov 2028

verdict.stance: Neutral / Qatar's Largest Islamic Bank (23.6% CAR, 1.51% NPL)
verdict.summary: QIB is Qatar's largest Islamic bank (QAR 235.5bn assets in 9M26) with exceptional capitalization (23.6% CAR under new QCB rules) and pristine asset quality (1.51% NPL, 95.1% coverage). Strong sovereign backing (QIA ~17%) anchors tight spreads.

positives: Sector-leading 23.6% Total CAR under updated Qatar Central Bank standards.
Resilient asset quality: 1.51% NPF ratio with 95.1% provisioning coverage in 9M26.
Strong Qatar sovereign systemic support (D-SIB status; QIA ~17% stake) and North Field macro tailwind.
negatives: 9M26 financing growth (+16.1% YTD to QAR 160.7bn) outpaced deposit growth (+1.6%), tightening LDR.
High Qatari real estate and government/GRE sector concentration.
Tight IG senior sukuk spreads limit excess return vs BBB/BB CEEMEA.

background.business_overview: Qatar's premier Sharia-compliant commercial and retail bank.
background.asset_perimeter: QAR 160.7bn financing book across Qatar sovereign/GRE, real estate, and retail.
background.ownership_governance: Qatar Investment Authority (~17%), Qatari institutions & public (QSE: QIBK).

recent_drivers: 9M26: Assets QAR 235.5bn, financing +16.1% YTD to QAR 160.7bn, net profit QAR 3.53bn (+2% YoY), CAR 23.6%, NPL 1.51%.
2025A: FY25 assets QAR 221.1bn (+10.1% YoY), financing assets QAR 138.5bn, deposits QAR 142.7bn, net profit QAR 4,835m (+5.0%).

catalysts.impact: Confirms full-year LDR funding mix and cost of risk.
Monitors potential USD sukuk issuance to fund 16% loan growth.

management_guidance_tracker.variance_analysis: Strong internal capital retention keeps CAR well above QCB minimum.

management_questions.question: Explain the 9M26 gap between +16.1% financing growth and +1.6% deposit growth and wholesale sukuk plans for 2027.
Detail Stage 2 real estate contracting exposures and ECL coverage trends.
Confirm dividend payout ratio vs organic capital buffer post-QCB rule changes.
